**Finding: compliant** — no redline proposed.

The warranty package in Section 9(b) sits at or above the preferred position:

- **Scope**: performance to industry standards in all material respects (p0034), services free from errors materially affecting utility (p0038), no malicious code (p0036), compliance with applicable Laws (p0037, p0041), plus non-infringement and ownership warranties.
- **Duration**: better than preferred — the warranties are uncapped in time and run throughout the Term, rather than expiring after 12 months/90 days.
- **Disclaimer does not swallow the warranty**: Section 13 opens with "Except as expressly set forth herein" and carves out "the representations and warranties set forth in this Agreement," so the "as is"/"as available" language cannot reach Section 9(b). This is therefore not walk-away territory.

One sub-element noted in the rationale rather than flagged: the Agreement omits the express repair/replace/re-performance/refund mechanic. That is immaterial here because nothing designates any remedy as sole or exclusive, so we keep our full contractual remedies (subject only to the mutual consequential-damages waiver in Section 7 and the indemnities). Importing the model remedy sentence would arguably *reduce* our rights, since it is exercisable at the vendor's option — so it would be a mistake to propose it against ourselves.
